history.content: For years, AI leaders have touted healthcare as one of the clearest examples of where their technology will improve lives. Now “it is finally here,” Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman tells The Verge. The company claims to have developed an AI-powered tool it says can diagnose conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.The findings, published Thursday in one of the world’s most prestigious journals, Science, are based on tests pitting Microsoft’s AI system against human physicians on a series of scenarios drawn from medical case reports and emergency department data. Microsoft compiled the cases into its own benchmark, SDBench, which it plans to open-source. Designed to function like a panel of medical experts, Microsoft’s Diagnostic Orchestrator uses multiple AI agents to reason through symptoms and medical histories, decide what tests to order, and arrive at a diagnosis, mimicking the process doctors use to investigate cases.On cases taken from hundreds of reports published in The New England Journal of Medicine, Microsoft’s system achieved a diagnostic accuracy of around 83 percent, compared with roughly 36 percent for generalist physicians using references and 22 percent for those working without them. The Diagnostic Orchestrator also outperformed doctors on emergency department cases drawn from a large database of patient admissions at the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center in Boston, scoring 80 percent accuracy compared with an average of 47 percent for human physicians. The AI system also tended to reach its diagnoses at a lower estimated cost than human counterparts.RelatedMicrosoft AI CEO says AI threats are real, and Anthropic is making it worseBill Gates thinks AI could make us live like the AmishInside Microsoft’s big Copilot rethinkThe researchers say that the system, which is powered by OpenAI’s GPT-5, also outperformed frontier AI models operating on their own, though the peer-reviewed paper does not include newer models like GPT-6 Astra, Meta’s Muse Wonder Full, Google’s Gemini 4 Argon, or Anthropic’s Opus 5.5. The Diagnostic Orchestrator was first developed when GPT-4.1 was the most advanced model available, but the researchers say subsequent testing suggests that “improvements in model capability do not necessarily diminish the benefits” of having multiple agents work together.Microsoft acknowledges there’s a long road ahead before the technology can be widely deployed. While the tests more closely mirror the way doctors diagnose conditions — asking questions, weighing possible explanations, and ordering tests before reaching a diagnosis — the system has only been tested on past medical cases and it remains unclear how well it would perform in real clinical settings. “It needs clinical validation,” Suleyman says. “That is a leap, but this is a major milestone along that journey.”The research is part of a broader ambition at Microsoft to develop what the company calls “medical superintelligence” — AI that can outperform the best human-led healthcare systems. Microsoft has used the term “superintelligence” since before Donald Trump and his administration co-opted it as a catch-all replacement for “AI.”Diagnosis is just part of Microsoft’s health vision, says the company’s AI health lead, Dr. Dominic King, a coauthor of the study. In a blog post published Thursday and a forthcoming article in the BMJ Digital Health & AI medical journal, the company outlines five other areas it believes AI will need to master, including coordinating clinical care, making treatment decisions, and handling the human side of medicine.King tells The Verge that Microsoft plans to begin testing the system in hospital settings with the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center to see how it performs in real-world clinical environments. Neither King nor Suleyman would commit to a firm timeline, though King says it will likely “get underway in the next couple of months.”Commercialization could also be on the horizon, though Microsoft has yet to say when or how the technology might become available. The company already has a significant presence in US healthcare through its digital tools, and health is one of the most popular uses for its consumer-facing chatbot Copilot. King emphasizes the need for a responsible rollout, noting the high regulatory and compliance requirements in medicine that would need to be followed.“Next year we’re going to see extremely impressive deployments of intelligent systems in production,” Suleyman says. “I think that this is just going to change the way care is delivered in a big way.”Suleyman has spoken previously about his “human-centered” vision for AI, and said medicine is no exception. Even as he predicts the arrival of “something that is indistinguishable from human performance on medical superintelligence in the next couple of years,” he insists that human clinicians should and will always have a central role in patient care.While he acknowledges AI could end up with doctors being handed more work, he says his hope is that it will take some of “the drudgery” out of medicine, freeing up clinicians to spend more time with patients.“I’m very optimistic about what’s coming next,” he says. “I think this is why we build technology.”

history.titleZh: 微软称其AI工具在诊断疾病方面优于医生
history.descriptionZh:
微软AI部门宣布开发出一款AI诊断工具，声称其在特定测试中的诊断准确率最高可达人类医生的四倍。相关研究已发表于《Science》，测试基于医学病例报告和急诊科数据，将微软AI系统与人类医生进行对比。微软还将其整理的测试集命名为SDBench，并计划开源。

该系统的核心是“诊断编排器”（Diagnostic Orchestrator），设计上模拟一个由多位医学专家组成的会诊小组。它利用多个AI代理协同工作，对症状和病史进行推理，决定需要安排哪些检查，并最终给出诊断，模仿医生调查病例的流程。该系统由OpenAI的GPT-5驱动。研究称，它在此前单独运行的前沿AI模型面前也表现更好；不过，同行评审论文并未纳入GPT-6 Astra、Meta的Muse Wonder Full、谷歌Gemini 4 Argon或Anthropic Opus 5.5等更新模型。诊断编排器最初在GPT-4.1为最先进模型时开发，但研究人员表示，后续测试表明，“模型能力的提升不一定削弱多代理协作带来的收益”。

性能方面，在取自《新英格兰医学杂志》数百篇病例报告的测试中，微软系统诊断准确率约为83%，而使用参考资料的全科医生约为36%，不使用参考资料的全科医生约为22%。在波士顿贝斯以色列女执事医疗中心大型患者入院数据库的急诊病例中，该系统准确率为80%，人类医生平均为47%。此外，AI系统给出诊断的估计成本通常低于人类医生。

微软承认，该技术距离广泛部署仍有很长的路要走。虽然测试更接近医生诊断的方式——提问、权衡可能解释、在诊断前安排检查——但系统仅在过去医学病例上测试，真实临床环境中的表现仍不清楚。微软AI CEO穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示：“它需要临床验证。这是一次跨越，但这是该旅程中的一个重大里程碑。”

这项研究是微软更广泛目标的一部分，即开发其所谓的“医学超级智能”，即能够超越最佳人类主导医疗系统的AI。微软AI健康负责人、论文合著者多米尼克·金博士表示，诊断只是微软健康愿景的一部分。公司在博客文章和即将发表于《BMJ Digital Health & AI》的文章中，概述了AI还需掌握的另外五个领域，包括协调临床护理、做出治疗决策以及处理医学中的人性化层面。

金表示，微软计划与贝斯以色列女执事医疗中心合作，在医院环境中开始测试该系统，以观察其在真实临床环境中的表现，预计“未来几个月内”启动，但未承诺具体时间表。商业化也可能提上日程，但微软尚未说明何时或以何种方式推出该技术。微软已通过数字工具在美国医疗领域拥有显著存在，健康也是其面向消费者的聊天机器人Copilot最热门用途之一。金强调负责任推广的必要性，指出医学领域有很高的监管和合规要求需要遵守。

苏莱曼预计，“明年我们将看到智能系统在生产环境中非常令人印象深刻的部署”，并认为这将“在很大程度上改变护理提供方式”。他一直倡导“以人为本”的AI愿景，称医学也不例外。尽管他预测“未来几年将出现与人类在医学超级智能上表现无法区分的东西”，但他坚持人类临床医生应该也将会始终在患者护理中发挥核心作用。他承认AI可能导致医生被分配更多工作，但希望它能消除医学中的一些“繁琐工作”，让临床医生有更多时间陪伴患者。

history.titleZh: 巴西机场被盗的价值47万美元的Nvidia RTX 5090显卡货物现身网络出售，序列号确认身份
history.descriptionZh:
近日，一起涉及英伟达旗舰显卡RTX 5090的机场盗窃案出现新进展。据巴西媒体和GMC报道，此前有消息称一批价值约47万美元的RTX 5090显卡在巴西机场失窃；随后，一张与该批货物相关的赃物显卡出现在巴西二手交易平台OLX上出售。巴西电视新闻网络称，其中一张为Zotac Gaming RTX 5090，标价超过6000美元。不利的是，卖家上传了能清晰显示显卡序列号的照片，序列号将该卡与失踪货物直接关联。报道称，目前没有信息能确认卖家身份，该商品列表似乎已被下架。

报道还援引警方信息还原了事件链条和可能的嫌疑人。该批货物从美国进口，价值据称接近50万美元，于9月20日抵达巴西，9月24日在海关登记。两个托盘在9月25日被授权放行后失踪。警方认为，9月21日两名外包叉车操作员将托盘从仓库移走，相关行为被闭路电视记录。警方称，设备被装上卡车后便再未出现。另有第三名“检查员”员工被指在系统中放行货物，使其通过电子管控。瓜鲁柳斯国际机场发表声明称，事实调查由主管机关负责，以查明事件情况。

从背景看，RTX 5090是当前全球最强的消费级游戏GPU，但受AI算力需求高涨影响，该卡在常规零售渠道几乎消失，仅在少数剩余市场流通，且价格已升至1万美元以上，且几乎均由第三方卖家提供。因此，一批无人看管的高价值显卡货物很容易成为盗窃目标。此次事件不仅反映出高端GPU供需紧张和市场价格高企，也暴露出高价值电子货物在机场物流、仓储和海关放行环节的安保漏洞，以及内外勾结风险。同时，赃物显卡因序列号被公开而暴露关联，说明序列号追踪和二手平台监控在追查此类案件中具有重要作用。原文未涉及RTX 5090的具体技术原理、架构创新或性能参数对比，核心内容是一起高价值GPU货物失窃及后续调查、销赃线索和市场背景事件。

history.content: It was a busy summer for AI lobbyists. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Nvidia each had their highest-spending lobbying quarter between July and September, federal disclosures show.Nvidia spent the most of the group at $2.2 million, followed by Anthropic’s $2.1 million and OpenAI’s $1.5 million. Compared to other Big Tech companies with long-established presences in Washington, the sums aren’t out of the ordinary. Microsoft, for example, has spent at least $2 million a quarter going back to 2021, and Google regularly spends over $3 million, including this quarter. But it’s a clear signal that the three AI firms recognize how important shaping policy has become.Tech CEOs were already visible fixtures in Washington during this period, with many of them attending a White House lunch with President Donald Trump in late September, which resulted in a “morally binding” AI safety accord that they agreed to. The lobbying disclosures show that even more discussions were happening frequently behind the scenes, during a time just before Trump named his AI czar and task force. With Democrats expected to win back at least some control in Congress after this year’s midterm elections, AI companies may only find it more important to engage with lawmakers who see cracking down on the industry as a winning issue.Anthropic included a detailed list of bills, executive orders, and other topics it lobbied Congress and the White House about in the third quarter. Among them were AI-related provisions in the Kids Online Safety Act, export control provisions in the AI Overwatch Act, Trump’s executive order renaming AI “Super Intelligence,” and the Ratepayer Protection Act, which aims to put energy costs for data centers on their developers.AI companies are becoming increasingly active in policymakingOpenAI’s lobbying looks like a response to some of the fallout from the Hugging Face attack, though the disclosures only list high-level topics. In addition to engaging on issues like copyright, OpenAI lobbied Congress, the White House, the Small Business Administration, and the Commerce and State Departments over cybersecurity evaluations for frontier models, AI safety oversight frameworks, and antitrust protections for information sharing. Nvidia lobbied Congress, as well as several different federal agencies and White House offices, on issues including 6G networks, “responsible AI design,” competition policy, quantum computing, and export control policy.Apple also had a record-breaking quarter, spending $3.1 million and engaging on issues including intellectual property, tariffs, kids online safety, competition, and domestic semiconductor manufacturing. It engaged on bills that seek to put the onus on app stores to verify users’ ages, for example. It’s the first quarter in which Apple has reported spending more than $3 million on lobbying.The disclosures show that leading AI companies are becoming increasingly active in policymaking, in a quarter that marks a lead-up to the midterm elections. OpenAI didn’t even spend $1 million on lobbying in a single quarter until this year, and it didn’t spend more than half a million until the end of 2024. The most Anthropic spent in a single quarter last year was just over $1 million. And this quarter is the first in which Nvidia has spent more than $2 million. With issues like data center development and AI safety on many voters’ minds, AI lobbyists’ work will likely only increase no matter whichever party has control next year.

history.titleZh: OpenAI、Anthropic和英伟达游说支出创季度纪录
history.descriptionZh:
今年7月至9月，美国主要AI公司明显加大了在华盛顿的政策游说力度。联邦披露文件显示，Anthropic、OpenAI和Nvidia均创下各自单季度游说支出最高纪录：Nvidia支出220万美元，Anthropic为210万美元，OpenAI为150万美元。与长期深耕华盛顿的大型科技公司相比，这一金额尚属正常水平——微软自2021年以来几乎每季度至少支出200万美元，谷歌则经常超过300万美元，本季度也不例外——但对三家AI公司而言，这清楚表明它们已认识到塑造政策的重要性。

这一轮游说升温发生在中期选举前的关键政策窗口。科技公司CEO在此期间频繁现身华盛顿，多名CEO于9月底参加白宫午餐，并与总统特朗普达成一项“具有道德约束力”的AI安全协议。披露文件还显示，在特朗普任命AI事务主管并组建特别工作组之前，AI公司与政府之间已有大量幕后沟通。随着民主党预计在中期选举后至少夺回部分国会控制权，而部分议员将加强对AI行业的监管视为有竞选吸引力的议题，AI公司与立法者接触的重要性可能进一步上升。

从具体议题看，Anthropic详细列出了其第三季度游说国会和白宫涉及的法案、行政令和其他事项，包括《儿童在线安全法》中的AI相关条款、《AI Overwatch Act》中的出口管制条款、特朗普将AI更名为“Super Intelligence”的行政令，以及旨在要求数据中心开发商承担能源成本的《Ratepayer Protection Act》。OpenAI的游说议题包括版权、前沿模型网络安全评估、AI安全监督框架，以及为信息共享提供反垄断保护等；其接触对象涵盖国会、白宫、小企业管理局以及商务部和国务院。Nvidia则就6G网络、“负责任的AI设计”、竞争政策、量子计算和出口管制政策等议题，游说国会、多个联邦机构和白宫办公室。苹果本季度也创下游说支出纪录，达310万美元，首次单季超过300万美元，议题涉及知识产权、关税、儿童在线安全、竞争和国内半导体制造，并涉及要求应用商店验证用户年龄的法案。

本文的核心并非某项技术突破，而是AI产业政策参与机制的变化：领先AI公司正通过直接游说国会、白宫和联邦机构，深度介入前沿模型安全评估、出口管制、竞争政策、版权、数据中心能源成本、半导体制造、6G和量子计算等政策议题。这一趋势也体现在支出增长曲线上：OpenAI在今年之前单季度游说支出从未达到100万美元，直到2024年底才超过50万美元；Anthropic去年单季度最高仅略高于100万美元；Nvidia本季度则是首次超过200万美元。总体来看，在数据中心建设、AI安全和平台责任等问题日益受到选民关注的背景下，无论明年哪个政党控制国会，AI公司的游说活动都很可能继续增加。

history.title: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories
history.description: Launched today, NVIDIA Minerva is an AIOps platform built to help teams find problems earlier and keep AI factories productive. AI factories are among the most complex operations in the world, with vast […]
history.content: Launched today, NVIDIA Minerva is an AIOps platform built to help teams find problems earlier and keep AI factories productive. It brings together telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads, then applies purpose-built AI models to turn that data into timely, actionable insight. AI factories are among the most complex operations in the world, with vast numbers of GPUs working across high-speed networks to train models and serve AI applications. At that scale, a single degraded component can slow an entire job. The warning signs may be easy to miss, such as a GPU running hotter than its peers or an NVMe drive losing performance under load. The platform focuses on AI factory yield, a measure of the useful work infrastructure produces through GPU hours, goodput, cluster uptime and token production. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Delivering a Dynamic View of an AI Factory Traditional monitoring tools often divide the data center into separate views. Networking, compute, site reliability and machine learning teams each see a different part of the operation. Minerva connects those signals across NVIDIA GPUs, networking, storage, schedulers and workloads. With these signals, Minerva builds a dynamic knowledge graph that logically maps the infrastructure — GPUs, SuperNICs, switches and cables — and the jobs running on it. This context helps operators trace a slow training job to the component affecting it, even across a factory with hundreds of thousands of GPUs. It analyzes billions of data points per hour using supervised and unsupervised machine learning. It learns normal behavior, detects previously unseen anomalies, predicts emerging failures and correlates related events based on the factory’s topology. Instead of sending every symptom to an operator, it can group an event storm into a focused incident with a likely root cause. Minerva comes with a native AI assistant and connects to external agentic AI tools. This adds a natural-language interface grounded in live telemetry. Operators can investigate cluster health and receive recommended remediation through conversation. Teams can keep a person in the loop to manually implement fixes or connect Minerva to automation through infrastructure application programming interfaces and external systems. Results That Maximize AI Factory Yield The ability to correlate workload and infrastructure issues along with its agentic AI capabilities help simplify AI factory operations. Instead of dealing with a blizzard of alerts, Minerva aggregates related problems into a single actionable item. This allows AIOps teams to move from reactive to proactive maintenance. And all of this helps AI factories maximize GPU uptime. Minerva delivers value for the key metrics AI factories focus on: Longer time between interruptions: Minerva spots trouble before it happens, so jobs run longer without incident. Faster time to repair: When an incident does happen, Minerva pinpoints the problem, leading to a significantly quicker resolution. Greater insight: Modern AI infrastructure generates a flood of data; Minerva filters it out, leaving only the handful of alerts that actually matter. IREN is among the NVIDIA partners using Minerva to optimize its AI factories. “As we scale our AI factories, the key to providing the best service for our customers is maximizing the productivity of our GPUs,” said Denis Skrinnikoff, chief technology officer of IREN. “NVIDIA Minerva gives our operations team one view across the network, the GPUs and the jobs running on them, so we focus more on proactive maintenance rather than troubleshooting. That visibility strengthens our operating model for the infrastructure we’re building next.” Joining IREN, Aolani, Bitdeer AI, IBM, Jio, Lambda, Quake AI and Tesla plan to deploy Minerva. In addition to Dell Technologies, Lenovo and Supermicro will offer Minerva as part of their AI factory operations portfolios. Learn more about NVIDIA Minerva. history.titleZh: 英伟达推出Minerva，为AI工厂带来端到端可观测性
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA今日发布Minerva，这是一个面向AI工厂的AIOps平台，目标是帮助运维团队更早发现问题，并保持AI工厂持续高效产出。AI工厂是当前最复杂的计算设施之一：大量GPU通过高速网络协同训练模型、提供AI应用服务，在这种规模下，单个组件性能退化就可能拖慢整个作业，而预警信号往往并不显眼，例如某块GPU温度高于同批设备，或NVMe存储在负载下性能下降。Minerva聚焦“AI工厂良率”（yield），即通过GPU小时、有效吞吐、集群正常运行时间和token产出等指标衡量基础设施实际产生的有效工作量。

传统监控工具通常将数据中心割裂为网络、计算、站点可靠性和机器学习等不同视图，各团队看到的是不同片段。Minerva则跨NVIDIA GPU、网络、存储、调度器和工作负载连接这些信号，并构建动态知识图谱，将GPU、SuperNIC、交换机和线缆等基础设施与运行其上的作业进行逻辑映射。借助这种上下文，运维人员可以把一个变慢的训练作业追溯到影响它的具体组件，即使整个工厂拥有数十万块GPU。平台每小时分析数十亿个数据点，结合监督学习和无监督机器学习，学习正常行为、检测此前未见的异常、预测潜在故障，并依据工厂拓扑关联相关事件。它不会把每个症状都直接推给操作员，而是能把大量告警聚合成一个聚焦事件，并给出可能的根因。

Minerva还内置原生AI助手，并可连接外部代理式AI工具，提供基于实时遥测的自然语言接口。操作员可以通过对话调查集群健康状况，并获得修复建议；团队既可以让人员留在流程中手动实施修复，也可以通过基础设施API和外部系统将Minerva接入自动化流程。其核心价值在于将工作负载问题与基础设施问题关联起来，并利用代理式AI简化AI工厂运维：把大量相关告警归并为单个可操作事项，推动运维团队从被动响应转向主动维护，从而最大化GPU正常运行时间。具体效果包括：延长无中断运行时间，在故障发生前发现隐患；缩短修复时间，在事故发生时快速定位问题；提升洞察力，从海量数据中过滤出真正重要的少量告警。

IREN是使用Minerva优化AI工厂的NVIDIA合作伙伴之一。IREN首席技术官Denis Skrinnikoff表示，随着AI工厂规模扩大，为客户提供最佳服务的关键是最大化GPU生产力；Minerva让运维团队在一个视图中同时看到网络、GPU及其上运行的作业，从而更专注于主动维护而非故障排查，这种可见性将强化公司未来基础设施的运营模式。除IREN外，Aolani、Bitdeer AI、IBM、Jio、Lambda、Quake AI和Tesla也计划部署Minerva；Dell Technologies、Lenovo和Supermicro将把Minerva纳入其AI工厂运维产品组合。

history.title: TSMC is seeking chipmaking equipment that doesn't contain Chinese rare-earth magnets
history.description: TSMC is reportedly asking equipment suppliers for factory machinery that doesn't use rare-earth components, as the chipmaker seeks to reduce exposure to China’s dominance of critical minerals and permanent magnets.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter TSMC, the world's largest contract chip manufacturer, is seeking alternative machinery without rare-earth components to reduce its dependence on China-dominated materials and avoid disruptions to factory operations caused by the country's export controls. According to a Reuters report on October 22 citing people familiar with the matter, the Taiwanese company has begun approaching its equipment suppliers to explore whether they can provide factory automation equipment equipped with motors that don't require rare-earth materials.Go deeper with TH Premium: Chipmaking (Image credit: tsmc)Analyzing TSMC's fab expansion roadmap — multi-fab N2 ramp, CoWoS, SoIC, and uncorking bottlenecksLeading-edge foundry roadmaps for TSMC, Intel, and SamsungASML's roadmap for chipmaking lithography tools examinedChinese chipmaking tool roadmaps examinedTSMC supplies the extremely powerful Nvidia chips that are facilitating the AI boom. It also manufactures chips for Apple, Broadcom, Qualcomm, and numerous other tech and automotive companies. The company operates enormous, highly automated semiconductor fabrication plants. These factories use industrial machinery that relies on electric motors with powerful permanent magnets made from rare-earth elements such as neodymium, dysprosium, and terbium.According to the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), China accounts for roughly 70% of global rare earth mining. The International Energy Agency (IEA) says China also controls around 90% of refining and approximately 95% of the finished permanent magnets found in TSMC’s machines, giving Beijing a quasi-absolute monopoly over one of the most critical technology supply chains. In April 2025, the country placed seven medium and heavy rare earths and the magnets made from them under export controls, requiring exporters to seek case-by-case approval and export licenses, thereby choking shipments to manufacturers across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, including TSMC.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: China expanded the controls on October 9, 2025, to include five additional rare earths, processing technology and equipment, and even products manufactured outside the country that contain more than 0.1% Chinese-origin rare earths, or are made using Chinese processing technology. It later suspended the October expansion for one year, until November 10, 2026. This has now been extended for an additional 90 days.TSMC’s moves aim to reduce the risk that these controls will hinder production at its factories. Even with all other raw materials and machinery required to manufacture its chips, shortages of specialized motor components could complicate the maintenance, repair, or expansion of its production equipment. Several technological approaches allow motors to avoid rare earth magnets. Conventional induction motors, for example, generate torque using electromagnetic induction rather than permanent magnets. Switched-reluctance motors are another option, while some permanent-magnet motors can use ferrite magnets instead of rare-earth magnets. However, these technologies typically involve different trade-offs in efficiency, size, power density, precision, and control requirements. Taiwan is reportedly pursuing domestic rare-earth production capabilities in collaboration with the United States, with both countries confirming their intent to reduce reliance on Chinese rare-earth and critical-mineral supply chains.Taiwan's government is supporting the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) in establishing a pilot production line within three years that could supply about 50% of Taiwan's domestic rare-earth demand. Meanwhile, the U.S. is “working with Taiwan and other partners to develop alternative sources of supply, expand processing capacity and build more resilient supply chains,” according to the report. history.titleZh: 台积电寻求不含中国稀土磁体的芯片制造设备
history.descriptionZh:
全球最大晶圆代工厂台积电正寻求不含稀土材料的替代机械与零部件，以降低对中国主导稀土供应链的依赖，并避免中国出口管制可能造成的晶圆厂运营中断。据路透社10月22日援引知情人士报道，台积电已开始接触设备供应商，探讨其能否提供配备无需稀土材料电机的工厂自动化设备。台积电为英伟达供应支撑AI热潮的高性能芯片，也为苹果、博通、高通等众多科技与汽车企业代工芯片，其运营着高度自动化的大型半导体晶圆厂。这些工厂的工业机械依赖电动机，而电动机中的强永磁体通常由钕、镝、铽等稀土元素制成。

背景在于中国在稀土供应链中的主导地位。美国地质调查局数据显示，中国约占全球稀土开采量的70%；国际能源署指出，中国还控制约90%的稀土精炼能力和约95%的成品永磁体供应，使北京在关键技术供应链中形成近乎绝对的垄断。2025年4月，中国将七种中重稀土及其制成的磁体纳入出口管制，要求出口商逐案申请审批和许可证，导致对美国、欧洲和亚洲制造商——包括台积电——的出货受到抑制。2025年10月9日，中国进一步扩大管制范围，新增五种稀土、相关加工技术与设备，甚至将境外制造但含有超过0.1%中国原产稀土、或使用中国加工技术生产的产品纳入管辖。随后，中国将10月扩围措施暂停一年至2026年11月10日，此后又延长90天。台积电此举旨在降低这些管制措施阻碍其工厂生产的风 险：即便其他原材料和机械齐备，专用电机部件短缺也可能使生产设备的维护、维修或扩产变得复杂。

从技术原理看，避免稀土永磁体的电机方案主要有几类。传统感应电机通过电磁感应产生转矩，不依赖永磁体；开关磁阻电机利用磁阻变化产生转矩，是另一种选择；部分永磁电机则可用铁氧体磁体替代稀土磁体。不过，这些方案在效率、尺寸、功率密度、精度和控制要求等方面通常存在不同取舍。例如，感应电机技术成熟、成本较低，但功率密度和效率可能不及稀土永磁电机；开关磁阻电机结构简单、耐高温潜力较好，但转矩脉动、噪声和控制复杂度较高；铁氧体永磁成本低，但磁能积明显低于钕铁硼等稀土永磁材料。因此，台积电寻找替代设备并非简单“替换零件”，而是涉及自动化设备电机在性能、可靠性和维护周期上的系统权衡。

这一动向的影响不仅限于台积电自身。它反映出半导体制造业对关键材料供应链风险的高度敏感，也可能推动设备供应商开发无稀土或低稀土电机方案，并加速全球构建中国以外的稀土供应链。据报道，台湾正与美国合作提升本土稀土生产能力，台湾政府支持工业技术研究院在三年内建立试点生产线，目标供应约50%的台湾本地稀土需求；美国则表示正与台湾及其他伙伴开发替代供应源、扩大加工能力并建设更具韧性的供应链。2026年2月，特朗普政府还宣布计划建立120亿美元的关键矿产储备，以对冲来自中国的供应链风险。总体而言，台积电的探索是晶圆厂设备供应链“去风险”的早期信号，但无稀土电机能否在效率、精度和可靠性上满足先进晶圆厂高度自动化设备的要求，仍需设备商与制造商共同验证。

history.title: Cloud Deployment Incoming: ‘Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’ Arrives on GeForce NOW
history.description: Lock in and load out this GFN Thursday. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 arrives on GeForce NOW at launch, bringing a new campaign, multiplayer action and DMZ, high-stakes extraction mode to supported devices. The campaign also gets an enhanced look: GeForce RTX 5080-class performance arrives for Ultimate members, bringing support for ray-tracing features in […]
history.content: Lock in and load out this GFN Thursday. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 arrives on GeForce NOW at launch, bringing a new campaign, multiplayer action and DMZ, high-stakes extraction mode to supported devices. The campaign also gets an enhanced look: GeForce RTX 5080-class performance arrives for Ultimate members, bringing support for ray-tracing features in the cloud. There’s a new way to join the cloud, too: Existing supported Fire TV Stick users can now purchase one-month Performance or Ultimate memberships directly through Amazon, making it easier to sign up and start streaming on the big screen. Plus, Square Enix’s FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE brings cinematic pixel art and strategic battles to the cloud, and The Elder Scrolls Online’s Echoes of Skyrim Season adds the entire Greymoor Chapter free for all ESO Standard Edition owners. It’s all part of six games joining the GeForce NOW library this week. Deployment Without the Downloads Squad up and answer the call on the cloud. Activision and Infinity Ward’s Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches today on GeForce NOW. Members can drop into the trenches in Korea, close-quarter combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, night raids in Mumbai and city-wide engagements to reclaim occupied territory. Fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad as a routine patrol turns into a desperate fight for survival. Beyond the front lines, operator-turned-outlaw Captain Price is operating outside the system he once served, pursuing revenge through covert missions as the conflict spreads. Multiplayer pairs precise combat with fluid movement, a dozen core 6v6 maps from around the world and battlegrounds that are shaped by the campaign’s global conflict. The DMZ extraction mode sends players into contested territory to recover valuable technology, weigh objectives and decide when to get out. Loot, fight, negotiate, betray and extract — it’s all fair in the cloud and battleground. Ultimate members can now experience the campaign with ray tracing, powered by newly added GeForce RTX 5080-class performance across PCs, Macs, handhelds, mobile devices, browsers, supported TVs and more. With game downloads and installs handled by GeForce NOW, members can spend less time preparing a local rig and more time preparing the next loadout. A New Way to Play A new way to join GeForce NOW on Fire TV. GeForce NOW in-app purchase is rolling out to existing supported Fire TV Stick users, making it possible to purchase a membership directly through Amazon using an existing account. Transactions are processed through Amazon’s billing system, creating a more seamless path from setup to gameplay. GeForce NOW transforms Fire TV into a powerful PC gaming rig in the cloud. Members can stream supported PC games they already own or purchase new titles from digital stores including Steam, Epic Games Store, Ubisoft Connect, Xbox PC Game Pass, GOG and EA. The library includes thousands of ready-to-play games, including many of the world’s most-played titles and more than 100 free-to-play games. No downloads, installs, patches or updates stand between a new game and playtime. An Amazon Fire TV Stick, the GeForce NOW app and an Ultimate membership are all it takes to level up the living room with GeForce RTX 5080-powered gaming. A Pixel-Perfect Fantasy Classic roots. A new adventure. Square Enix’s FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE launches today on GeForce NOW, bringing the series’ classic roots into a cinematic pixel-art world. Travel with companions bound by fate and uncover the truth behind a force threatening to bring everything to ruin. Strengthen the party with Visions of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, each bringing unique skills and abilities to battle. Dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models give familiar fantasy a fresh perspective. Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger foes, break their defenses and seize extra turns before finishing the bonus phase with powerful Resonance attacks. Airships, crystals, espers and moogles bring familiar series favorites to a world filled with secrets to discover. GeForce NOW handles the game’s downloads and storage in the cloud, leaving more space on supported devices for everyday essentials. Save the inventory management for potions and Phoenix Downs. Step Into a New Season in Tamriel Familiar lands. Fresh reasons to return. The Elder Scrolls Online’s second season, Echoes of Skyrim, launched Wednesday, Oct. 21, free for all ESO players and ready to stream through GeForce NOW. Season Two gives everyone who owns ESO Standard Edition access to its Skyrim content and the Antiquities treasure-hunting system. The Markarth downloadable content follows Monday, Nov. 9, rounding out the additions with two classic zones to explore. The Season also introduces Solo Dungeons, reimagining challenges previously designed for groups. Moon Hunter Keep and March of Sacrifices have been redesigned and rebalanced for players ready to tackle their dangers alone. Earn new rewards and take on new challenges at your own pace without needing to find a group. A new Tamriel Tome also launched Oct. 21, offering both free and premium battle pass reward tracks. In addition, members can look for the following titles joining the GeForce NOW library this week: We Were Here Tomorrow (New release on Steam, Oct. 20) FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE (New release on Steam, Oct. 22) Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (New release on Oct 23, available in the Call of Duty app) CONTROL Resonant (Epic Game Store) Crimson Desert (Epic Games Store) Planet Zoo 2 (Xbox app, supports XBOX Play Anywhere) Dates listed above reflect when games are released on their respective stores. GeForce NOW availability may vary, as games are onboarded after release and added throughout the week. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW channels and GFN Thursdays for availability updates on announced titles. Gamers who want to test out high-performance GeForce NOW cloud gaming can start with a day pass to try premium cloud gaming before committing to a membership. Better yet, the cost of the day pass can be applied toward a first monthly membership — making it easy to try GeForce RTX-powered cloud gaming with the latest releases, then level up for more. What’s on the mission board this weekend? Let us know on X or in the comments below.

history.titleZh: 云端部署来袭：《使命召唤：现代战争4》登陆 GeForce NOW
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 在最新一期 GFN Thursday 中宣布，GeForce NOW 云游戏平台迎来多项重要更新：动视与 Infinity Ward 的《使命召唤：现代战争4》在发售首日即登陆 GeForce NOW，Ultimate 会员还可在云端以 GeForce RTX 5080 级性能体验支持光线追踪的战役模式；Fire TV Stick 现有受支持用户可通过 Amazon 应用内购买 Performance 或 Ultimate 会员；Square Enix 的《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》以及《上古卷轴OL》的“Echoes of Skyrim”第二赛季等六款游戏本周加入云游戏库。

从背景看，GeForce NOW 是 NVIDIA 的云游戏服务，核心思路是把 PC 游戏的渲染、下载、安装、补丁和存储放在云端完成，再把画面以流媒体形式传输到用户设备。此次更新的技术重点在于云端 GPU 实例升级：Ultimate 会员获得“GeForce RTX 5080 级”性能，使《使命召唤：现代战争4》战役模式能够在云中启用光线追踪。官方未披露具体分辨率、帧率等细项，但这一升级意味着用户无需本地拥有高端 RTX 显卡，也能在 PC、Mac、掌机、移动设备、浏览器、受支持电视等设备上获得接近高端 PC 的画质与特效体验。其创新点不仅是硬件升级，更在于把光追这类高负载图形特性与“即点即玩”的云串流结合，减少本地装机、下载和调优成本。

游戏内容方面，《使命召唤：现代战争4》带来新战役、多人模式和 DMZ 高风险撤离模式。战役围绕年轻韩国士兵 Private Park 及其小队展开，场景包括韩国战壕、纽约近距离战斗、巴黎高速追逐、孟买夜间突袭以及夺回被占领土的城市战；同时，操作员出身的法外者 Captain Price 在体系外展开复仇行动。多人模式强调精准战斗与流畅移动，提供十余张全球核心 6v6 地图，并以战役中的全球冲突塑造战场。DMZ 模式则要求玩家进入争夺区域，回收有价值技术，权衡目标并决定撤离时机，包含拾取、战斗、谈判、背叛和撤离等玩法。Ultimate 会员可在该战役中体验云端光追，借助新加入的 RTX 5080 级性能提升画面表现。

渠道与门槛方面，GeForce NOW 的应用内购买正面向现有受支持 Fire TV Stick 用户推出。用户可直接通过 Amazon 使用现有账户购买一个月 Performance 或 Ultimate 会员，交易由 Amazon 计费系统处理，从而简化从注册到开玩的路径。GeForce NOW 可将 Fire TV 变成云 PC 游戏设备：会员可串流已拥有的受支持 PC 游戏，也可从 Steam、Epic Games Store、Ubisoft Connect、Xbox PC Game Pass、GOG 和 EA 等数字商店购买新游戏。平台库包含数千款可玩游戏，其中包括大量热门作品和 100 多款免费游戏；下载、安装、补丁和更新均由云端处理，用户只需 Fire TV Stick、GeForce NOW 应用和 Ultimate 会员即可在客厅获得由 RTX 5080 级性能支持的云游戏体验。这一变化的技术影响在于进一步降低云游戏订阅和硬件门槛，应用场景从 PC 桌面扩展到客厅大屏和轻量终端。

本周其他重点包括：Square Enix 的《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》以电影化像素艺术和战略战斗登陆 GeForce NOW，采用动态镜头和像素化 3D 模型，玩家可与命运相连的伙伴冒险，借助系列经典角色的“Visions”强化队伍，利用敌人弱点造成硬直、打破防御并争取额外回合，最后以强力“Resonance”攻击结束奖励阶段；游戏下载和存储由云端处理，为设备节省空间。《上古卷轴OL》第二赛季“Echoes of Skyrim”于 10 月 21 日上线，对所有 ESO 玩家免费，标准版拥有者可获得 Skyrim 内容和 Antiquitities 寻宝系统；Markarth DLC 于 11 月 9 日推出，增加两个经典区域。该赛季还引入 Solo Dungeons，将此前面向组队设计的 Moon Hunter Keep 和 March of Sacrifices 重新设计并平衡为单人挑战，玩家可按自己的节奏获取新奖励；新的 Tamriel Tome 战斗通行证也于 10 月 21 日推出，包含免费和付费奖励轨道。

本周加入 GeForce NOW 库的六款游戏包括：《We Were Here Tomorrow》（Steam 10 月 20 日新发售）、《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》（Steam 10 月 22 日新发售）、《使命召唤：现代战争4》（10 月 23 日新发售，通过 Call of Duty 应用提供）、《CONTROL Resonant》（Epic Games Store）、《Crimson Desert》（Epic Games Store）和《Planet Zoo 2》（Xbox 应用，支持 Xbox Play Anywhere）。上述日期为各商店发售时间，GeForce NOW 可用性可能因游戏上线后逐步接入而有所不同，并会在本周陆续更新。对于想先体验高性能云游戏的用户，GeForce NOW 提供日票，且日票费用可抵扣首月会员，便于先用最新作品测试 RTX 级云游戏，再决定是否升级长期订阅。整体来看，此次更新体现了云游戏平台在高端 GPU 云端化、光追云串流、客厅轻终端入口和多商店游戏库整合上的持续推进，使高画质 PC 游戏进一步摆脱本地硬件和下载安装限制。

history.title: AMD Ryzen 5 5500F review: Vermeer rides again for budget gaming PCs
history.description: After years with the Cezanne-based 5500, AMD has finally updated its $100 CPU to the 5500F in the Vermeer family, adding a 200 MHz boost in clock speed and a PCIe 4.0 upgrade.
history.content: We often criticise companies for misleading marketing, which typically falls in the direction of deceitful overpromising. With the Ryzen 5 5500F, we have the opposite problem. Its name and branding undersell what AMD is offering here. It’s a marked improvement over the base Ryzen 5 5500, giving AMD better standing among the best budget CPUs.The 5500F is a Zen 3 CPU from the Vermeer family of chips, packing six cores, 12 threads, and a boost clock of 4.4 GHz. It’s modest by the standards of the best CPUs for gaming, but it also comes in at a suggested retail price of just $100. Those prices have drifted up toward $120, though hopefully they’ll settle down around list price before long.Along with a 200 MHz jump in boost clock speeds over the 5500, the 5500F critically comes with access to PCIe 4.0. The original 5500 came from the Cezanne family of APUs, which all use monolithic dies and are limited to PCIe 3.0. Although the 5500F lives in the Vermeer family alongside the main Zen 3 stack, it’s still limited to the 16 MB of L3 cache that characterizes Cezanne (Vermeer chips have access to 32 MB of L3 otherwise).Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The chip squarely targets Intel’s Core i3-14100F, a quad-core CPU available for around $100 that offers 11% better gaming performance at 1080p on average compared to the base 5500. The new 5500F tightens that gap to just 2.9%, and it manages to outclass Intel in multithreaded performance while offering a 10% average jump over the base 5500.AMD Ryzen 5 5500F (AMD Ryzen 5) at Amazon for $119.08AMD Ryzen 5 5500F specifications and pricingAMD gave the Ryzen 5 5500F a bad name. The “F” suffix across both AMD and Intel is typically used to note chips that lack integrated graphics. And indeed, the Ryzen 5 5500F does lack integrated graphics. But so does the Ryzen 5 5500. In reality, the Ryzen 5 5500F isn’t a re-released CPU with the iGPU sliced off, as F-series processors usually are, but rather an updated Ryzen 5 5500 that comes with better specs and, in turn, better performance.If there’s any chip that falls in the bucket of a re-released CPU with the iGPU cut off, it’s the original Ryzen 5 5500, not this new F-suffix variant. The Ryzen 5 5500 comes from the Cezanne family of Zen 3 CPUs. These chips use the Zen 3 microarchitecture, but they have only 16MB of L3 cache and are limited to PCIe 3.0. Out of the full Cezanne family, the Ryzen 5 5500 is the only chip that isn’t either an APU like the Ryzen 5 5600G, or a laptop chip.The newer Ryzen 5 5500F is from the Vermeer family, the same as other Zen 3-based desktop CPUs like the Ryzen 5 5600X. history.titleZh: AMD Ryzen 5 5500F 评测：Vermeer 再度归来，面向预算型游戏 PC
history.descriptionZh:
Tom's Hardware 对 AMD 新款 Ryzen 5 5500F 的报道指出，这款产品与常见的“营销夸大”相反：它的命名和品牌定位反而低估了实际规格与性能。Ryzen 5 5500F 相比基础版 Ryzen 5 5500 有明显提升，也让 AMD 在百美元级预算 CPU 市场中更具竞争力。

从背景看，Ryzen 5 5500F 属于 AMD Zen 3 架构的 Vermeer 家族，采用 6 核 12 线程设计，加速频率为 4.4 GHz，建议零售价仅 100 美元；不过实际市场价格一度升至约 120 美元，报道希望其后续回落到建议零售价附近。它的直接竞争对手是 Intel Core i3-14100F：后者为四核 CPU，价格约 100 美元，在 1080p 游戏性能上平均比基础版 Ryzen 5 5500 强 11%。Ryzen 5 5500F 将这一差距缩小到仅 2.9%，同时在多线程性能上超过 Intel，并比基础版 5500 平均提升约 10%。

核心技术变化在于平台规格和频率。Ryzen 5 5500F 相比 Ryzen 5 5500 将加速频率提高了 200 MHz，更关键的是支持 PCIe 4.0。原版 Ryzen 5 5500 来自 Cezanne 家族，采用单片式 die，仅支持 PCIe 3.0；Ryzen 5 5500F 虽然仍保留部分 Cezanne 特征——它是唯一共享 16 MB L3 缓存的 Vermeer 芯片，而其他 Vermeer 芯片至少拥有 32 MB L3，X3D 型号更高——但因为它属于 Vermeer 家族，所以获得了 PCIe 4.0 支持。这对 GPU 和存储性能都有明显好处。两款芯片共享 Zen 3 微架构，因此 L1/L2 缓存配置相同。

命名方面，报道认为 AMD 给 5500F 起了一个容易误解的名字。AMD 和 Intel 的“F”后缀通常表示没有集成显卡，Ryzen 5 5500F 确实没有核显；但原版 Ryzen 5 5500 同样没有核显。因此 5500F 并不是通常意义上的“切掉核显后再发布”的 F 系列产品，而是规格更高、性能更好的 Ryzen 5 5500 升级版。报道甚至认为，如果真的要说哪款芯片像“切掉核显的再发布产品”，那反而是原版 Ryzen 5 5500：它来自 Cezanne 家族，是该家族中唯一既不是 APU（如 Ryzen 5 5600G）也不是笔记本芯片的产品。

规格对比上，Ryzen 5 5500F 为 6 核 12 线程，基础/加速频率 3.0/4.4 GHz，L2+L3 缓存合计 19 MB，TDP 65W，平台最大功耗 88W；Ryzen 5 5500 为 3.6/4.2 GHz，同样 19 MB 缓存和 65W/88W；Ryzen 5 5600X 为 3.7/4.6 GHz、35 MB 缓存；Ryzen 5 5600G 为 3.9/4.4 GHz、19 MB 缓存。5500F 保留 65W TDP 和 88W 平台最大功耗，并附带 AMD Wraith Stealth 散热器，足以在负载下保持冷却，可节省额外购买散热器的成本。

应用场景上，Ryzen 5 5500F 主要面向预算级游戏和多线程工作负载，尤其是 1080p 游戏。PCIe 4.0 的加入提升了 GPU 和高速存储的带宽潜力，但 16 MB L3 缓存仍限制其与更高端 Vermeer 产品的差距。总体来看，5500F 以约 100 美元的建议价提供了接近 Intel i3-14100F 的游戏表现、更强的多线程性能，以及比基础版 5500 更好的平台规格，是百美元级预算 CPU 中值得关注的选择；其“F”命名虽然容易让人低估，但产品本身是对基础版 5500 的实质性升级。

history.title: Google’s TPUs for AI workloads now run in Meta's data centers
history.description: Google’s TPUs now serve AI in production at Meta, through new open-source engines that run PyTorch models natively on the chips.

A matching version of vLLM, another widely used inference engine, was also announced as open source.Previously, both engines used Google’s own JAX AI framework to run on TPUs. The new versions allow the hardware to be a native option for PyTorch, mostly without rewriting.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible“SGLang-TorchTPU is running in production at Meta today” after “a close three-way collaboration between Meta, Google, and the SGLang team,” said Meta’s PyTorch-TPU lead Zongwei Zhou. That team works at RadixArk, a startup founded by SGLang’s creators, which built the engine with Google and Meta. The engine, he said, gives Meta “a remarkably mature, PyTorch-native serving stack.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Jana van Greunen, director of PyTorch engineering at Meta, added in Google’s TorchTPU post that Meta “cannot be constrained by a single hardware architecture” and that TorchTPU “enables us to deploy our PyTorch workloads to Google TPUs.” Google said it co-developed TorchTPU with Meta’s PyTorch team. (Image credit: Google)This is not Meta’s first attempt at using TPUs. Google calls PyTorch/XLA, the older bridge from PyTorch to TPUs, a "predecessor" to the new TorchTPU, and SemiAnalysis reported last year that Meta research teams used TPUs through this bridge from 2020 to 2023 before Meta canceled those contracts. Google’s PyTorch-on-TPU push was aimed mainly at Meta, which did not want to migrate to JAX. history.titleZh: 谷歌用于AI工作负载的TPU现已在Meta的数据中心运行
history.descriptionZh:
谷歌正推动其自研 AI 芯片 TPU 进一步融入主流 PyTorch 生态：Meta 已通过新的 PyTorch 原生 SGLang 推理引擎，在 TPU 上生产环境运行 AI 服务；同时，另一主流推理引擎 vLLM 的 PyTorch 原生 TPU 版本也已开源。此前，SGLang 和 vLLM 在 TPU 上主要依赖谷歌自家的 JAX 框架运行，新版本使 TPU 成为 PyTorch 的原生硬件选项，且大多数情况下无需重写代码。

**背景与发布内容**

SGLang-TorchTPU 已“在 Meta 今天处于生产运行状态”。Meta 的 PyTorch-TPU 负责人 Zongwei Zhou 表示，这来自 Meta、谷歌和 SGLang 团队的三方紧密合作。SGLang 团队所在的初创公司 RadixArk 与谷歌、Meta 共同构建了该引擎，为 Meta 提供了“一个相当成熟、PyTorch 原生的服务栈”。Meta 的 PyTorch 工程总监 Jana van Greunen 则强调，Meta“不能被单一硬件架构所限制”，TorchTPU“使我们能够把 PyTorch 工作负载部署到谷歌 TPU 上”。谷歌表示，TorchTPU 是与 Meta 的 PyTorch 团队共同开发的。

这并非 Meta 首次尝试使用 TPU。谷歌将旧的 PyTorch 到 TPU 桥梁 PyTorch/XLA 称为新 TorchTPU 的“前身”。据 SemiAnalysis 此前报道，Meta 研究团队曾在 2020 至 2023 年通过该桥梁使用 TPU，后来取消了相关合同。谷歌推动 PyTorch-on-TPU 的主要目标正是 Meta，因为 Meta 不希望迁移到 JAX。目前尚不清楚 Meta 生产环境中的 TPU 具体位于何处；此前有报道称，双方谈判内容包括 2026 年租赁谷歌云 TPU、2027 年进行采购，Meta 后来据称签署了多年期租赁协议。

**技术原理与创新点**

SGLang 和 vLLM 都是面向大语言模型的高吞吐推理引擎，负责模型服务中的调度、批处理、内存管理、算子执行等关键环节。此次创新的核心是 TorchTPU：它作为 PyTorch 到 TPU 的原生后端，使 PyTorch 模型和工具链能够更直接地面向 TPU 运行，减少过去为使用 TPU 而迁移到 JAX 或依赖旧式 PyTorch/XLA 桥接的成本。对于 SGLang 和 vLLM 而言，PyTorch 原生版本意味着它们可以保留 PyTorch 生态中的模型定义、优化工具和开发习惯，同时把推理负载部署到 TPU 上，实现“mostly without rewriting”，即大多数情况下无需重写。

性能优化方面，vLLM-TorchTPU 针对具体模型进行了内核优化，并采用投机解码（speculative decoding）加速推理。投机解码的原理是用一个较小的草稿模型先提出候选 token，再由大模型验证，从而提升大语言模型推理速度。SGLang-TorchTPU 还将继续增加模型支持，首批包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 Reflection Beam，并计划在 2027 年第一季度前实现新开放模型的“Day 0”TPU 支持，即在模型发布当天即可支持。

**性能参数与对比**

据 Inferact 提供的数据，在第七代 Ironwood TPU 上，经过调优的 vLLM 配置运行 Moonshot AI 的开放权重、2.8 万亿参数 Kimi K3 模型时，单用户推理速度据报道超过 700 tokens/s。该测试使用 16 颗 Ironwood TPU 并启用投机解码，对比 vLLM 公布的 16 个 Nvidia GB200 配置，后者达到 452 tokens/s。此外，其针对 Kimi K3 和 Qwen 3.8 27B 的内核，在不启用投机解码、小批量场景下，吞吐量约为 GB200 基线的 1.4 至 2 倍。Inferact 是由 vLLM 创建者创立的初创公司，曾帮助谷歌构建 vLLM-TorchTPU。需要注意的是，这些数字来自相关初创公司和特定测试配置，实际生产规模、部署位置和整体成本效益尚未完全披露。

**行业影响与应用场景**

这一进展的战略意义在于削弱 Nvidia 的软件生态锁定。长期以来，CUDA 生态是 Nvidia AI 芯片的重要护城河；而 PyTorch 原生 TPU 后端使客户可以在不大幅改写 PyTorch 工作负载的情况下使用谷歌 TPU，增加硬件选择空间。Meta 的生产验证尤其关键，因为 Meta 是 PyTorch 的主要维护者和大规模 AI 基础设施用户，其态度会影响其他企业对 TPU 的接受度。该事件发生前一天，亚马逊也在同一场 PyTorch Conference 上开源了面向 Trainium2 和 Trainium3 的 PyTorch 原生后端 TorchNeuron，显示主要云厂商都在通过“PyTorch 原生”降低自家 AI 芯片的使用门槛，并挑战 Nvidia 的软件锁定。

应用场景包括 Meta 等超大规模公司的生成式 AI 推理服务、开放权重超大模型的高吞吐部署、云上 TPU 租赁服务，以及企业希望保留 PyTorch 技术栈同时采用多元 AI 加速器的场景。谷歌、Meta 和 RadixArk 计划在 2026 年 11 月 12 至 13 日于旧金山举行的 SGLang Summit 2026 上分享更多细节。整体来看，TPU 正从依赖 JAX 的专用生态走向更广泛的 PyTorch 原生推理栈，AI 芯片竞争正从单纯硬件性能扩展到软件生态和开发者体验。

history.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
history.description: To help developers rapidly build world models, which help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world, NVIDIA has expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints.  Ranking top five on six different open models leaderboards, the NVIDIA Cosmos platform gives world model builders the frontier open […]
history.content: To help developers rapidly build world models, which help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world, NVIDIA has expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints. Ranking top five on six different open models leaderboards, the NVIDIA Cosmos platform gives world model builders the frontier open models — as well as data, training and optimization tools and recipes — to scale training data, adapt models, test behavior and optimize for performance before deployment. Build Better Training Data Building world models begins with multimodal, multisensory data. NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory brings together the tools and skills for labeling, curating, augmenting and evaluating data at scale for training physical AI. Cosmos Curator, a GPU-accelerated solution for curating video training datasets, has now added support for multimodal multisensory inputs and processing blocks. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Cosmos Data Factory now offers the following five cloud-native blueprints and is available through GitHub, Microsoft Azure, Nebius and CoreWeave: Autonomous Vehicle Dataset Generation: Curates and labels driving data, then adds synthetic examples of hard-to-capture scenarios to expand training coverage. Image Attribute Augmentation: Varies object appearance to improve image search. Event Video Generation: Turns still images into synthetic videos of rare or unsafe events. Defect Image Generation: Generates printed circuit board, metal and glass defect images for inspection models. Video Data Augmentation: Changes weather and lighting in existing footage while preserving scene structure. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/CDF-visual-Oct20.mp4 Cosmos Data Factory accelerates data curation, processing and synthetic data generation with agentic skills. Companies are already putting Cosmos Data Factory blueprints to work to speed their physical AI development workflows. Porsche is leading the development of a shared AV data flywheel across Volkswagen Group brands, using Cosmos Data Factory through Voxel51 on Microsoft Azure. This is expected to reduce repeated physical test drives by up to 90% and shorten development cycle times by up to 85%. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Porche-Cosmos-Data-Factory.mp4 Porsche searching and augmenting autonomous vehicle data footage in Voxel51, powered by Cosmos Data Factory. ANYbotics generated over 1,500 synthetic video clips with Cosmos Data Factory blueprints, curating real-world data and validating outputs with Encord’s platform, to train its industrial-inspection robots to recognize liquid spills and other changes between facility visits. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ANYbotics-Cosmos-Data-Factory.mp4 ANYbotics generating anomaly clips with Encord powered by NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory. Ultralytics, a computer vision company, retrained its YOLO model with real images and targeted synthetic defects generated using Cosmos Data Factory, improving defect localization and recall. Train, Adapt and Optimize Models With training data prepared, developers may train their own architecture or start with a pretrained model. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA extended Cosmos Framework training, optimization and deployment tools and recipes as agent skills to more open models, along with Cosmos 3, giving world model builders a faster path from experimentation to deployment. Developers and agents can now adapt open models like GR00T, Alpamayo, QWEN, Pi0.5 and other compatible Hugging Face models through fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, optimize the model with distillation and quantization, and deploy with high-performing inference. Cosmos Framework is an open, modular framework of model training and optimization tools and skills to accelerate world model development. To develop a world model specialized for egocentric manipulation, robotics research lab MicroAGI post-trained Cosmos 3 on videos of humans manipulating objects and distilled its 32-billion-parameter reasoner down to an 8-billion-parameter Nano model with no loss in accuracy. Developers can label data and post-train Cosmos 3 on Roboflow for their specific environments and tasks, then deploy those models to RoboFlow hosted or on-premises NVIDIA GPUs to bring video reasoning into factories and warehouses. Test Policies and Run Models Faster Alongside these tools, NVIDIA continues advancing foundational technology through its work on Cosmos models. New Cosmos 3 Nano model variants for simulation enable developers to test autonomous policies in repeatable, hard-to-capture, multiview multisensor scenarios. Accompanying code allows developers to adapt the models to train and evaluate their own policies for autonomous vehicles and bimanual robots in interactive simulations before real-world testing. Multiview and multisensory video data generation for evaluating policies in closed loop simulation. Developers can deploy core Cosmos models using updated NVIDIA Cosmos 3 NIM microservices, which deliver up to 2x faster inference with no quality loss in validated configurations, while continuous video analysis enables sub-second alerts. For vision AI developers, the new NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for video search and summarization (VSS) 3.3, built on Cosmos NIM microservices, turns one prompt into an efficient video AI application and helps teams monitor 40% more video streams with the same GPU. ADNOC uses Fogsphere’s MistIQ agentic platform, built with Cosmos and the NVIDIA Metropolis VSS Blueprint, to detect safety hazards in real time across 65 sites. For rare events, Fogsphere also uses the Cosmos Data Factory to generate synthetic training data, improving detection without needing to physically stage dangerous situations. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ADNOC-Cosmos.mp4 The Cosmos platform is fully modular and open. Developers can use Cosmos Data Factory to generate training datasets, Cosmos Framework to train and adapt world models, then deploy supported Cosmos models through NIM microservices. history.titleZh: NVIDIA Cosmos 推出用于训练、评估和部署世界模型的新工具
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA正在扩展其Cosmos平台，目标是帮助开发者更快构建“世界模型”，让物理AI系统能够理解和模拟真实世界。此次扩展包括新的训练工具、仿真检查点（checkpoints）以及Cosmos Data Factory蓝图（blueprints）。NVIDIA表示，Cosmos平台在六个不同的开放模型排行榜上均进入前五，面向世界模型构建者提供前沿开放模型，以及数据、训练、优化工具和配方，用于扩展训练数据、适配模型、测试行为，并在部署前优化性能。

背景上，物理AI系统要在真实环境中可靠运行，需要大量多模态、多感官数据来训练世界模型，并需要在仿真中反复测试策略。传统上，真实数据采集成本高、危险场景难以复现、长尾事件稀缺，成为世界模型和自主系统开发的主要瓶颈。Cosmos平台的核心思路是构建一个模块化、开放的工具体系：先用数据工厂生成和策展训练数据，再用框架训练和适配模型，最后通过微服务部署模型。

在数据侧，NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory把大规模数据标注、策展、增强和评估工具整合起来，并引入“智能体技能”（agentic skills）来加速数据策展、处理和合成数据生成。GPU加速的视频训练数据集策展方案Cosmos Curator新增了对多模态、多感官输入和处理模块的支持。Data Factory目前提供五个云原生蓝图，并可通过GitHub、Microsoft Azure、Nebius和CoreWeave获取：自动驾驶数据集生成，用于策展和标注驾驶数据，并补充难以采集场景的合成样本以扩大训练覆盖；图像属性增强，通过改变物体外观提升图像搜索能力；事件视频生成，把静态图像转化为稀有或不安全事件的合成视频；缺陷图像生成，为印刷电路板、金属和玻璃生成缺陷图像以训练检测模型；视频数据增强，在保持场景结构的前提下改变现有视频的天气和光照。

这些蓝图已进入实际生产流程。Porsche正在牵头为大众集团各品牌构建共享自动驾驶数据飞轮，通过Microsoft Azure上的Voxel51使用Cosmos Data Factory，预计可将重复的物理测试驾驶减少最多90%，并将开发周期缩短最多85%。ANYbotics利用Data Factory蓝图生成了超过1500个合成视频片段，并用Encord平台策展真实数据、验证输出，以训练工业巡检机器人识别液体泄漏和设施巡检间的其他变化。计算机视觉公司Ultralytics则用真实图像和Data Factory生成的定向合成缺陷重新训练YOLO模型，提高了缺陷定位能力和召回率。

在模型训练、适配和优化方面，NVIDIA在GTC Berlin上把Cosmos Framework的训练、优化和部署工具及配方扩展为智能体技能，覆盖更多开放模型，并推出Cosmos 3。开发者和智能体现在可以通过微调和强化学习适配GR00T、Alpamayo、QWEN、Pi0.5及其他兼容Hugging Face的开放模型，通过蒸馏和量化优化模型，并以高性能推理进行部署。Cosmos Framework本身是开放、模块化的模型训练与优化工具和技能框架，用于加速世界模型开发。机器人研究实验室MicroAGI的案例显示，其为自我中心操作任务开发专用世界模型时，在人类操作物体的视频上对Cosmos 3进行后训练，并把320亿参数的推理模型蒸馏为80亿参数的Nano模型，且精度没有损失。开发者还可以在Roboflow上标注数据并针对特定环境和任务后训练Cosmos 3，再把模型部署到Roboflow托管环境或本地NVIDIA GPU，将视频推理能力带入工厂和仓库。

在测试策略和加速运行方面，NVIDIA推出面向仿真的新Cosmos 3 Nano模型变体，使开发者能够在可重复、难以采集、多视图多传感器的场景中测试自主策略。配套代码允许开发者适配模型，在交互式仿真中训练和评估面向自动驾驶和双臂机器人的策略，然后再进入真实世界测试。平台还支持生成多视图、多感官视频数据，用于闭环仿真中的策略评估。更新后的NVIDIA Cosmos 3 NIM微服务可部署核心Cosmos模型，在经验证的配置下实现最高2倍推理加速且无质量损失，连续视频分析可支持亚秒级警报。面向视觉AI开发者，基于Cosmos NIM微服务的新NVIDIA Metropolis视频搜索与摘要蓝图VSS 3.3可将一个提示转化为高效的视频AI应用，并帮助团队在相同GPU上监控多40%的视频流。ADNOC使用Fogsphere基于Cosmos和Metropolis VSS蓝图构建的MistIQ智能体平台，在65个站点实时检测安全隐患；对于稀有事件，Fogsphere还利用Cosmos Data Factory生成合成训练数据，从而无需实际布置危险场景也能提升检测能力。

整体来看，Cosmos平台保持完全模块化和开放：开发者可用Data Factory生成训练数据集，用Framework训练和适配世界模型，再通过NIM微服务部署受支持的Cosmos模型。其创新点在于把数据生成、模型训练适配、闭环仿真测试和高效部署串成一条面向物理AI的开发流水线，并通过开放模型、蓝图和智能体技能降低世界模型开发门槛。性能数据方面，平台在六个开放模型排行榜进入前五，Porsche案例预计减少最多90%重复路测、缩短最多85%开发周期，ANYbotics生成1500多个合成视频片段，MicroAGI将32B模型蒸馏至8B且无精度损失，Cosmos 3 NIM实现最高2倍推理加速，Metropolis VSS 3.3在同等GPU下多监控40%视频流。这些能力将主要应用于自动驾驶、工业巡检机器人、双臂机器人、工厂与仓库视频推理、缺陷检测、安防与危险事件监测等场景。

history.title: How Companies Are Using NVIDIA DSX to Break the Power Bottleneck
history.description: Companies around the world are building on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run the grid and the AI factory as one system, from the substation to the rack. Their adoption of the platform responds to an acute problem. Power is now the biggest bottleneck in infrastructure. More than $300 billion […]
history.content: Companies around the world are building on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run the grid and the AI factory as one system, from the substation to the rack. Their adoption of the platform responds to an acute problem. Power is now the biggest bottleneck in infrastructure. More than $300 billion in equipment is backlogged, and over 200 gigawatts of projects are waiting in U.S. interconnection queues. One root cause of the bottleneck is siloed systems. The grid, the facility and the compute inside have long been designed independently from one another, creating the conditions for delays, risk and stranded capacity. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements To help address this, NVIDIA DSX brings these systems together: NVIDIA DSX Sim and SimReady assets from leading energy manufacturers let engineers simulate the grid, substation and AI factory together, validating generators, switchgear, power systems and cooling before breaking ground. NVIDIA DSX Flex syncs AI factory demand with grid conditions and onsite generation, turning AI factories from static loads into flexible grid assets. NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS and DSX Exchange squeeze more compute from every watt and securely share signals across compute, networking, energy, cooling and operations. GE Vernova is deploying its grid-to-facility and rack power expertise to complement NVIDIA DSX systems, enabling customers to transform power constraints into competitive advantages while maximizing compute and token output, sustainability and grid reliability. Hitachi Energy’s battery energy storage system has qualified as NVIDIA DSX Ready, helping customers identify power infrastructure that meets applicable NVIDIA DSX reference architecture design requirements for resilient, reliable and scalable AI factories. Schneider Electric, together with AVEVA and ETAP, is advancing NVIDIA DSX with validated NVIDIA Vera Rubin power and cooling reference architectures and an NVIDIA Omniverse-powered AI factory digital twin. Combining AVEVA’s engineering software expertise with NVIDIA SimReady assets, OpenUSD and Omniverse enables connecting simulations, real-time operational data and AI-driven optimization across AVEVA, Schneider Electric and third-party solutions. Together, these capabilities help organizations design, simulate, operate and optimize data centers across their lifecycle, improving energy efficiency and workload performance while accelerating time to token. Siemens Energy is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA by developing a reference design for resilient, scalable and grid-aware power infrastructure across power generation, transmission and distribution. This design is aligned with the requirements of the NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin AI factory design. The company is also exploring usingNVIDIA technologies such as RAPIDS, Metropolis and Isaac Sim for its Noedra digital twin platform, evaluating how the technologies could enhance grid infrastructure monitoring, identify emerging risks and support unplanned outage prevention. Phaidra integrated DSX Flex, DSX Max-Q and DSX Exchange into its self-learning agents, optimizing cooling and power allocation to maximize tokens per watt, improve grid flexibility and deliver about 10% more compute within the same power envelope. Emerald AI integrated its Conductor platform into DSX Flex to help utilities tap underused grid capacity, an approach modeled to unlock up to 100 gigawatts on the existing U.S. grid. Explore the NVIDIA Omniverse DSX Blueprint and the Vera Rubin DSX AI Factory Reference Design. Learn more from NVIDIA and energy leaders who are accelerating power-flexible AI factories to strengthen the grid at GTC Berlin. Visit Hitachi Energy (booth 7004, hall 7), Schneider Electric (booth 3041, hall 3) and Siemens Energy (booth 3048, hall 3) and tune into sessions with Schneider Electric on Wednesday, Oct. 21: From Grid to AI: Engineering the Future of AI Factories and Energy Intelligence: Powering the AI Era. history.titleZh: 企业如何借助 NVIDIA DSX 突破电力瓶颈
history.descriptionZh:
全球企业正在采用NVIDIA DSX AI工厂平台，将电网与AI工厂作为统一系统进行规划、仿真和运行，覆盖从变电站到机架的完整链路。其背景是电力已成为基础设施的最大瓶颈：超过3000亿美元设备积压，美国并网队列中还有逾200吉瓦项目等待接入。造成瓶颈的根源之一是系统孤岛——电网、设施和内部计算长期各自独立设计，导致工期延误、风险上升和容量搁浅。

技术上，DSX通过数字孪生和协同仿真打通这些环节。DSX Sim及来自领先能源制造商的SimReady资产，使工程师能在动工前联合仿真电网、变电站和AI工厂，验证发电机、开关设备、电力系统和冷却系统。DSX Flex将AI工厂的用电需求与电网条件和现场发电同步，使AI工厂从静态负载转变为可灵活调节的电网资产。DSX MaxLPS和DSX Exchange则从每瓦功率中挖掘更多算力，并在计算、网络、能源、冷却和运营之间安全共享信号。

生态合作方面，GE Vernova正将其从电网到设施及机架的电力专长与DSX系统结合，帮助客户把电力约束转化为竞争优势，同时最大化算力与token产出、可持续性和电网可靠性。Hitachi Energy的电池储能系统已获得NVIDIA DSX Ready资格，可帮助客户识别满足DSX参考架构设计要求的弹性、可靠、可扩展AI工厂电力基础设施。Schneider Electric联合AVEVA和ETAP推进DSX，提供经验证的NVIDIA Vera Rubin电力和冷却参考架构，以及由NVIDIA Omniverse驱动的AI工厂数字孪生；结合AVEVA工程软件、NVIDIA SimReady资产、OpenUSD和Omniverse，可连接仿真、实时运营数据和AI驱动优化，覆盖设计、仿真、运营和优化全生命周期，提升能效和工作负载性能，加速time to token。Siemens Energy则扩展与NVIDIA的合作，开发覆盖发电、输电和配电的弹性、可扩展、电网感知电力基础设施参考设计，并对齐NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin AI工厂设计要求；该公司还在探索使用RAPIDS、Metropolis和Isaac Sim增强其Noedra数字孪生平台，以提升电网基础设施监测、识别新兴风险并支持非计划停运预防。

在实际效果上，Phaidra已将DSX Flex、DSX Max-Q和DSX Exchange集成到其自学习代理中，优化冷却和功率分配，以最大化每瓦token产出、提升电网灵活性，并在相同功率包络内多提供约10%的算力。Emerald AI将Conductor平台集成到DSX Flex，帮助公用事业利用未充分使用的电网容量，建模显示该方案可在美国现有电网上释放最高100吉瓦容量。这些能力适用于AI数据中心规划、并网、供电与冷却设计、现场发电协同、公用事业容量激活以及全生命周期运维优化等场景。NVIDIA还发布了Omniverse DSX Blueprint和Vera Rubin DSX AI工厂参考设计，并将在GTC Berlin与能源行业领袖共同展示如何加速建设功率灵活型AI工厂、增强电网韧性。

history.title: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations
history.description: European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin. Frontier Results With Open Models Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open […]
history.content: European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin. Frontier Results With Open Models Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D. Shopify post-trains open models to reach frontier-level accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Its engineers use the NVIDIA Megatron Bridge library for faster fine-tuning and NVIDIA NeMo RL for reinforcement learning. Shopify has post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant for merchants. The subagent retrieves store data for several Sidekick features, including Sidekick Pulse, which researches a merchant’s store and recommends ways to improve it. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements On Shopify’s internal benchmark, the post-trained model surpasses a leading frontier model in accuracy while cutting serving costs by 90% and delivering responses 7x faster. Beyond Sidekick, NVIDIA CCluster vLLM inference optimization software helped Shopify achieve 4.5x faster performance and up to 12x lower inference cost across five additional use cases: catalog enrichment, merchant assistant, e-commerce shopping simulation, product taxonomy classification, and merchant and buyer recommendations. Zooplus, Europe’s leading online pet retailer, with Infosys and NVIDIA technologies rebuilt its product discovery stack for the agentic era. A production ready prototype deployed inside Zooplus’ Amazon Web Services (AWS) environment achieved 86% search accuracy using the NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever library for semantic search and the NVIDIA Blueprint for retail catalog enrichment for generated, search-ready product attributes. Photoroom results from its deployment with Vestiaire Collective, where its Image Editing API now standardizes every primary image, about 40,000 a day across 70 countries, at the point of listing. Listings processed by Photoroom sold at a 5% higher rate of liquidity, with 3% to 7% more unique views per product page. The pipeline runs on NVIDIA GPUs with TensorRT and Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo Snapshot can help users quickly respond to demand spikes. Omi launched ProductDrop, a workflow that anchors every generated image to an approved digital twin, letting brands scale creative output across entire catalogs without introducing product errors. L’Oréal is using this approach, combining Omi’s digital twins with generated brand environments within its CreAItech program. Omi runs TRELLIS 3D asset generation on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, speeding up inference by 10x and reducing pipeline latency by 4x. In addition, L’Oréal is accelerating the discovery of the best ingredient combinations, moving from months of experimentation to hours of computational screening, with the integration of NVIDIA ALCHEMI into its research workflow. L’Oréal is also testing this approach with CurieOS, Orbital Industries‘ operating system for science and engineering, using OrbMol-v2, its open source molecular simulation model. Integrated with the NVIDIA ALCHEMI Toolkit and powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing, OrbMol-v2 is five times faster than comparable models and delivers 21% lower error than the next-best model of its kind. This AI-based workflow enables researchers to identify the most promising ingredient combinations for solubilizing UV filters and optimizing performance before committing to laboratory testing. Mirakl, a software company for intelligent commerce, runs open models on NVIDIA GPUs, both on its own infrastructure and through European cloud providers like Scaleway. This keeps its technology sovereign, avoids vendor lock-in and delivers the speed and scale its customers expect. Mirakl’s Catalog Transformer pairs fine-tuned open models with proprietary services and has onboarded more than 70 million products, turning messy vendor data into accurate, well-organized catalogs. Physical Intelligence Enables Training in Simulation NVIDIA physical AI, digital twins and open models help simulate retail environments, automate warehouse operations and deliver virtual try-on experiences for European retailers and fashion brands. Otto Group advanced its autonomous warehouse under human supervision initiative — built with Reply on NVIDIA Omniverse libraries and running on Google Cloud — to the group’s largest fulfillment center in Haldensleben, Germany. New capabilities let logistics teams design, test and optimize warehouse operations entirely in simulation before any physical implementation. ALLSIDES launched its 3D Digital Twin Factory: an automated pipeline that transforms physical objects into SimReady 3D digital twins in minutes, capturing sub-millimeter geometric accuracy, measured physical properties and fully relightable materials that maintain accuracy under any lighting condition. Those digital twins serve as the foundation for simulating entire store layouts in 3D, as well as for tracking products reliably throughout the shopping journey and at checkout regardless of ambient light. Built on NVIDIA CUDA, OptiX and TensorRT, the platform already serves brands including adidas, Amazon, Nike, Zalando and Zara. CATCHES achieved production results from its RealFit deployment with AMIRI of conversion up 55%, add-to-cart up 80% and gross sales up 56%, all after seasonal adjustment against like-for-like styles. The company launched PredictiveFit, extending physics-based virtual try-on to retailers, as well as CASI, a personal fashion agent that shops, styles and sizes for customers over WhatsApp, powered by open weight models including NVIDIA Nemotron 3, built on NVIDIA Omniverse and the Newton Physics Engine. Explore New NVIDIA Retail Blueprints at the Nebius Booth At GTC Berlin, Nebius is showcasing three NVIDIA Blueprints for retail, all available in early access and running on Nebius infrastructure, accelerated by NVIDIA: Agent Harness for Employee Productivity: An agentic assistant that consolidates scheduling, task management, inventory alerts and operational insights for store managers. Inventory Simulation and Optimization: A blueprint that can help retailers reduce overstock and stockouts by modeling demand scenarios, testing replenishment strategies and optimizing stock levels before users need to commit in the real world. Agentic Finetuning Flywheel: A self-improving loop that uses agentic workflows to continuously generate training data, fine-tune open source models and feed real-world performance back into the next training cycle. Request early access to the blueprints and learn more about NVIDIA technologies for retail and consumer packaged goods. See notice regarding software product information. 欧洲零售业正加速采用开放模型与“物理智能”，覆盖代理式商务、商品发现、研发、仓储自动化和虚拟试穿等场景。其共同背景是：零售商希望在控制成本、保持技术主权和避免供应商锁定的同时，利用前沿AI能力提升搜索、推荐、内容生成、供应链和门店运营效率。NVIDIA及其生态伙伴通过加速计算、开放模型、推理优化软件、数字孪生和仿真工具，为这些应用提供底层支撑。

在开放模型与代理式商务方面，Shopify对开放模型进行后训练，以远低于前沿模型的成本达到前沿级准确率。其工程团队使用NVIDIA Megatron Bridge库加快微调，并用NVIDIA NeMo RL进行强化学习；Shopify后训练了NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，用于集成到商家AI助手Sidekick中的GraphQL子代理。该子代理为Sidekick Pulse等功能检索店铺数据，研究商家店铺并给出改进建议。在Shopify内部基准上，后训练模型准确率超过领先前沿模型，同时服务成本降低90%，响应速度提升7倍。除Sidekick外，NVIDIA CCluster vLLM推理优化软件还帮助Shopify在目录丰富、商家助手、电商购物模拟、产品分类、商家与买家推荐五个额外用例中实现4.5倍性能提升和最高12倍推理成本降低。

欧洲宠物电商Zooplus与Infosys、NVIDIA合作，为代理式时代重建产品发现技术栈。其在AWS环境中部署的生产就绪原型使用NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever库进行语义搜索，并采用NVIDIA零售目录丰富蓝图生成可搜索的产品属性，实现86%的搜索准确率。Photoroom与Vestiaire Collective的部署则显示，其图像编辑API在商品上架时标准化每张主图，每天约处理70个国家的4万张图片；经处理的商品售出流动性提高5%，每个产品页面的独特浏览量增加3%至7%。该流水线运行在NVIDIA GPU上，使用TensorRT和Triton Inference Server，并可通过NVIDIA Dynamo Snapshot快速应对需求峰值。

在生成式内容与研发方面，Omi推出ProductDrop工作流，将每张生成图像锚定到已批准的数字孪生，使品牌能够在不引入产品错误的情况下扩展整个目录的创意输出。欧莱雅正在其CreAItech项目中结合Omi数字孪生与生成的品牌环境使用这一方法。Omi在NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU上运行TRELLIS 3D资产生成，推理速度提升10倍，流水线延迟降低4倍。欧莱雅还将NVIDIA ALCHEMI集成到研究流程中，把最佳成分组合发现从数月实验缩短到数小时计算筛选；其与Orbital Industries的CurieOS及开源分子模拟模型OrbMol-v2测试该方案。OrbMol-v2集成NVIDIA ALCHEMI Toolkit并由NVIDIA加速计算驱动，比同类模型快5倍，误差比次优同类模型低21%，可在实验室测试前识别溶解UV过滤剂并优化性能的最有希望成分组合。Mirakl则在自有基础设施和Scaleway等欧洲云提供商上运行NVIDIA GPU上的开放模型，以保持技术主权并避免锁定；其Catalog Transformer将微调开放模型与专有服务结合，已接入超过7000万种产品，把杂乱的供应商数据转化为准确、组织良好的目录。

物理智能方面，NVIDIA物理AI、数字孪生和开放模型用于模拟零售环境、自动化仓库运营和提供虚拟试穿。Otto Group与Reply基于NVIDIA Omniverse库并在Google Cloud上运行，将其“人类监督下的自主仓库”计划推进到德国Haldensleben的最大履约中心。新能力使物流团队能够在任何物理实施之前，完全在仿真中设计、测试和优化仓库运营。ALLSIDES推出3D Digital Twin Factory自动化流水线，可在数分钟内将物理对象转化为SimReady 3D数字孪生，具备亚毫米级几何精度、可测量的物理属性以及在任何光照条件下保持准确性的完全可重打光材质。这些数字孪生可用于3D模拟整个店铺布局，并在购物旅程和结账环节可靠跟踪产品。该平台基于NVIDIA CUDA、OptiX和TensorRT，已服务adidas、Amazon、Nike、Zalando和Zara等品牌。CATCHES与AMIRI的RealFit部署取得生产结果：经季节性调整并与同类款式对比，转化率提升55%，加购率提升80%，总销售额提升56%。CATCHES还推出PredictiveFit，将基于物理的虚拟试穿扩展给零售商，并推出CASI个人时尚代理，通过WhatsApp为顾客提供购物、造型和尺码建议，由包括NVIDIA Nemotron 3在内的开放权重模型驱动，并基于NVIDIA Omniverse和Newton物理引擎构建。

在GTC Berlin上，Nebius展示了三个处于早期访问阶段的NVIDIA零售蓝图，均运行在Nebius基础设施上并由NVIDIA加速：面向员工生产力的Agent Harness，可整合排班、任务管理、库存警报和运营洞察；库存模拟与优化蓝图，通过建模需求场景、测试补货策略和优化库存水平，帮助零售商减少库存过剩和缺货；代理微调飞轮，则利用代理工作流持续生成训练数据、微调开源模型，并将真实世界表现反馈到下一轮训练，形成自我改进循环。整体来看，这组案例表明开放模型、推理优化、数字孪生和物理仿真正在把零售AI从单点试验推向可量产的代理式商务、智能商品发现、研发筛选、仓储优化和虚拟试穿，并带来显著的成本、速度和业务转化收益。

history.content: Weather forecasts shape more than daily plans; timely weather information is crucial for energy producers, insurers and transport operators to plan around changing conditions. A global forecast can show a storm taking shape, but decisions about solar farms, shipping routes or insured property depend on what happens locally. NVIDIA Earth-2 gives developers and researchers a family of open AI models and tools they can customize with their own data. Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements StormScope EU is the latest model to join Earth-2 — a regional version of the StormScope model for short-term forecasting, trained over Europe weather and climate data. It uses EUMETSAT satellite observations to predict evolving cloud conditions across 16 Meteosat channels at 10-minute intervals. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing a live StormScope EU pipeline in an interactive weather demo built in partnership with Earthmover. The demo uses Earth2Studio to run forecasts and Earthmover’s data platform to manage and serve the real-time results, which are updated as soon as new satellite observations come in, every 10 minutes. Earthmover serves these results as map tiles, letting visitors explore predictions across Europe without downloading entire datasets. Developers can combine Earth-2 models in workflows tailored to regional needs, using StormScope for short-term forecasting and CorrDiff to add local detail to coarser weather data. Developers can also pick up these model architectures and train them for new environmental applications such as air-quality modeling. The open source NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo framework provides training and customization tools so teams can build applications that incorporate proprietary data and domain expertise to meet regional needs. Organizations building on Earth-2 capabilities include: AXA is using NVIDIA Earth-2’s FourCastNet 3 to study regional cyclone risk beyond the historical record across more than 1,000 simulated seasons, generating insights that can inform risk assessments and help customers target prevention efforts. Vaisala Xweather is combining Earth-2 with its proprietary observations, lightning data and forecasting expertise to enhance its weather intelligence platforms for government, energy, maritime, transportation and insurance customers. Its work includes adapting StormScope with lightning data to advance short-term forecasting lead time and make these warnings accessible through Vaisala Xweather’s software-as-a-service offerings and AI-assistant integrations. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Vaisala-Xweather-Nvidia-StormScope.mp4 Video courtesy of Vaisala Xweather. University of Manchester researchers adapted the Earth-2 CorrDiff model for U.K. air-quality modeling. It trained the model on the NVIDIA-powered Isambard-AI supercomputer and ran it locally on NVIDIA DGX Spark systems, bringing environmental modeling from a national supercomputer to the desktop. TotalEnergies is exploring NVIDIA Earth-2 for solar-energy forecasting, evaluating StormScope-based solar-radiation nowcasts at two photovoltaic sites and developing models to provide weather information at subhourly intervals. The work explores how more detailed forecasts could help anticipate changes in solar-power generation. Space42 developed SARDiff4Height using CorrDiff and NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo. The research estimates surface heights from a single radar image and produces uncertainty maps, helping analysts understand where estimates need closer scrutiny. Explore NVIDIA Earth-2 open models and tools, and explore with Earth2Studio’s forecasting examples. Read AXA’s hurricane-risk case study and Manchester’s air-quality story to learn how teams are adapting weather AI to specialized challenges. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

history.titleZh: 欧洲各地先驱部署NVIDIA Earth-2开放模型，助力真实世界天气与气候预测
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA Earth-2 是面向开发者和研究者的开放式 AI 天气模型与工具家族，可在 NVIDIA 计算平台上运行，覆盖全球天气预报、区域精细化预报以及环境研究。其背景在于：天气预报不仅影响日常出行，更关系到能源生产、保险定价与理赔、运输和物流运营等关键决策。全球模型能显示风暴形成趋势，但太阳能电站、航运路线和保险财产等决策往往依赖本地尺度的天气变化，因此需要可定制、可区域化的 AI 预报能力。

最新加入 Earth-2 的区域模型是 StormScope EU。它是 StormScope 短期预报模型的欧洲区域版本，使用欧洲天气和气候数据训练，并利用 EUMETSAT 卫星观测预测云况演变。该模型覆盖 16 个 Meteosat 卫星通道，以 10 分钟为间隔更新预测。在 GTC Berlin 上，NVIDIA 与 Earthmover 合作展示了实时 StormScope EU 流水线：Earth2Studio 负责运行预报，Earthmover 数据平台负责管理和提供实时结果；每当新的卫星观测到达，结果即每 10 分钟更新，并以地图瓦片形式提供，用户无需下载完整数据集即可浏览欧洲范围内的预测。开发者还可以按区域需求组合 Earth-2 模型工作流，例如用 StormScope 做短期预报，再用 CorrDiff 为较粗分辨率天气数据补充局地细节；也可复用这些模型架构，训练空气质量等新的环境应用。开源 NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo 框架则提供训练和定制工具，帮助团队把自有数据和领域知识纳入应用，满足区域需求。

从已披露的参数和流程看，StormScope EU 的关键能力包括 10 分钟更新频率、16 个 Meteosat 通道的卫星观测输入，以及面向欧洲的区域短临预报；Earth-2 工作流支持将短期预报与 CorrDiff 局地降尺度结合。应用侧的数据点包括：AXA 使用 Earth-2 的 FourCastNet 3 研究区域气旋风险，覆盖 1000 多个模拟季节，以生成超越历史记录的风险洞察；TotalEnergies 在两个光伏电站评估基于 StormScope 的太阳辐射临近预报，并开发亚小时级天气信息模型；曼彻斯特大学将 CorrDiff 适配到英国空气质量建模，在 NVIDIA 驱动的 Isambard-AI 超级计算机上训练，并在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 系统上本地运行，使环境建模从国家超算走向桌面。原文未给出与传统模型的具体精度或速度量化对比数据，但上述更新频率、通道数、模拟规模、亚小时级预报和本地化运行体现了其区域化、实时化和可定制化方向。

在生态应用上，Vaisala Xweather 将 Earth-2 与其专有观测、闪电数据和预报专长结合，增强面向政府、能源、海事、交通和保险客户的天气智能平台，并改造 StormScope 以利用闪电数据提升短期预报预警提前量，通过 SaaS 和 AI 助手集成提供预警。Space42 则利用 CorrDiff 和 PhysicsNeMo 开发 SARDiff4Height，从单张雷达图像估计地表高度并生成不确定性图，帮助分析人员判断哪些估计需要进一步核查。整体来看，Earth-2 的技术影响在于把开放模型、卫星观测、实时数据平台和领域数据结合起来，使区域短临预报、降尺度、风险评估和环境建模更容易被能源、保险、交通、政府和科研用户定制和部署。
